spans.text: Investigations from the orchestrator session are **read-only**. Inspect status, logs, metadata, PR state, and worker output, but do not edit repository files or implement fixes from the orchestrator session.
spans.note: The prompt enforces strong tool/action safety through its read-only investigation rule, delegation of all code changes to worker sessions, prohibition against direct runtime access, and structured communication via `ao send`. These constraints implement least-privilege principles and protect system integrity.
